title: EFC v2.1 -- Modular Synthesis
abstract: Modular decomposition of the EFC framework into structural, dynamical, entropic, and informational modules. Each module can be analysed, validated, or extended independently while maintaining a consistent global architecture. Complements the v2.1 Complete Edition.
key_results: Decomposes EFC into four independent modules: Structural, Dynamical, Entropic, Informational
Each module has defined inputs, outputs, and interface contracts
Modules can be validated independently against observational data
Global consistency constraints ensure inter-module coherence
Enables incremental extension without breaking existing modules
